title: Concept: Gradle plugin applied without a version
description: build.gradle declares a plugin request that names no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The plugin resolves to its latest release, and a build plugin runs arbitrary code during configuration, so the change is both invisible and code-executing.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: The plugin resolves to its latest release, and a build plugin runs arbitrary code during configuration, so the change is both invisible and code-executing.
